decision.reason: The candidate passes byte exactness, CPU-oracle, ISA, resource, and named-launch gates but misses the earlier continuation threshold by 12.05%; the measured 2.43 us/call median saving projects only 0.0729 ms/token over 30 calls.
decision.next: Proceed to the next structurally distinct SH-D1 work rather than full-model gating this sibling; non-temporal same-layout loads precede any byte-neutral paired-Q8T32 materializer/runtime work. Continue the overall campaign through SH-D1 selected experts, SH-M2, SH-K1, SH-A1, and SH-G.
